Name: Twitch Viewer Deck
Author: Enfalion
Description: Ultimate Twitch Viewer Plugin (Live Avatars, Auto-Rotating Live Slots, Live Switcher, Quick Chat !lurk & MultiTwitch) - Auto DE/EN

Actions.Name: Favorite Streamer (Live Status)
Actions.Tooltip: Displays streamer avatar (Grayscale = Offline, Color = Live + 100% Optional Badges)

Actions.Name: Dynamic Live Slot (Auto-Rotate)
Actions.Tooltip: Displays currently live followed channels with automatic rotation

Actions.Name: Dynamic Live Switcher
Actions.Tooltip: Shows total live count & cycles all Dynamic Live Slots on press

Actions.Name: Quick Chat / !lurk (Channel Icon)
Actions.Tooltip: Shows channel avatar & sends !lurk or custom message on short press

Actions.Name: MultiTwitch Split-Screen
Actions.Tooltip: Opens 2 to 4 streams side-by-side in a single split-screen window
